data.description: Identify cache, temporary, and redundant files, and free up storage space in one click
data.descriptionEn: Identify cache, temporary, and redundant files, and free up storage space in one click
data.descriptionZh: 识别缓存、临时、冗余文件，一键释放存储空间
data.readme:
· Find large, old, empty, temporary, cache, and duplicate files.
· Require confirmation before processing; moves to recycle bin by default for easy recovery
